organization_name: Baseline Reference Policy Pack (Replace with Organization Counsel-Reviewed Pack)
default_disclaimer: *A deterministic, human-in-the-loop screening aid governed by a versioned compliance policy pack. It never auto-rejects candidates, is not legal advice, and does not replace an independent bias audit or organization counsel review where required by law.*
right_to_clarify_template: The following job requirements were **not detected** on your submitted application text. If you hold any of these qualifications under different terminology or omitted them from your resume, you have the right to submit a clarification or updated resume to the recruiting team to trigger a deterministic re-score and human review:

rules.title: Colorado Artificial Intelligence Act (SB 24-205) — Principal Factor & Correction Notice
rules.statute_citation: Colo. Rev. Stat. § 6-1-1701 et seq. (SB 24-205, as amended)
rules.review_notes: Covers principal scoring factors (Components 1-5), human oversight status, and statutory right to correct inaccurate application data.
rules.notice_heading: Colorado SB 24-205 Automated Assessment & Factor Disclosure
rules.notice_clause: Pursuant to Colorado SB 24-205, this notice discloses the principal job-related factors evaluated by the deterministic requirement-alignment rubric, confirms that a human reviewer makes all disposition decisions, and provides a direct mechanism to clarify or correct any unverified qualification.

rules.title: New York City Local Law 144 (AEDT) — Candidate Notice & Selection-Rate Tables
rules.statute_citation: N.Y.C. Admin. Code § 20-871 et seq. / 6 RCNY § 5-300 et seq.
rules.review_notes: Provides deterministic reference scoring, job qualifications evaluated, and sex/race/ethnicity selection-rate & impact-ratio tables for independent bias auditors.
rules.notice_heading: NYC Local Law 144 Job Qualifications & Features Disclosure
rules.notice_clause: In support of NYC Local Law 144 transparency workflows, this notice lists the specific job qualifications and features evaluated from your submitted resume text alongside the exact quoted lines.

rules.title: Illinois Human Rights Act AI Amendment (HB 3773) — AI Notice & ZIP Proxy Prohibition
rules.review_notes: Enforces 5/9-digit ZIP code stripping in blind mode so geographic codes are never used as a proxy for protected classes, and discloses automated assessment usage.
rules.notice_heading: Illinois HB 3773 Automated Assessment & Geographic Proxy Protection Notice
rules.notice_clause: Pursuant to Illinois HB 3773 (effective January 1, 2026), 5- and 9-digit ZIP codes are stripped prior to scoring so geographic location cannot act as a proxy for protected classes.

rules.title: EEOC Uniform Guidelines on Employee Selection Procedures — Four-Fifths (80%) Rule
rules.review_notes: Computes group selection rates and 0.80 impact ratios post-scoring from segregated voluntary self-ID data.
rules.notice_clause: All scored items trace directly to documented job requirements in the requisition configuration, and demographic self-identification data is never accessible to the scoring engine.

rules.title: Age Discrimination in Employment Act (ADEA) — Graduation-Year Proxy Redaction
rules.review_notes: Redacts graduation dates inside the Education section during blind screening while preserving work-experience date ranges for net tenure math.
rules.notice_clause: Education graduation dates are redacted prior to scoring to prevent age-proxy inference while preserving work-experience date ranges for relevant tenure calculation.

rules.title: Multi-State Pay Transparency Statutes (CO, CA, NY, WA, IL, MN, MD, DC, MA)
rules.review_notes: Controls Requisition Quality Audit Rule P1 (-8 pts when pay range is omitted on covered or remote-eligible job postings).
rules.notice_clause: Requisition Quality Audit Rule P1 verifies whether a good-faith base salary or hourly wage range is disclosed in the job posting.
